verdict.rationale: Stable's public API docs say it supports searching for and retrieving MailItems, authenticated with x-api-key headers and dashboard-managed API keys. Webhooks are also available, so listing and ingesting mail programmatically is documented. However, nothing in the pack shows that scan images or PDFs can be downloaded through the API. Scans are only described as a product feature, and no machine-readable OpenAPI spec was found at the standard paths. Missing for 10: documented scan/attachment download endpoint, MailItem object schema showing scan URLs, OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration.
